+    # log_file_rotation: Rotate log_file in process instead of relying on an
+    # external tool. Requires log_file to be set. Unlike the SIGUSR2 mechanism
+    # above, this works on every platform. It is the only option on Windows,
+    # where an external tool can move the log file aside but has no way to tell
+    # spire-agent to start a new one.
+    # Rotation moves the accumulated content aside to a timestamped sibling
+    # (e.g. agent-2026-08-18T22-43-01.123.log) and keeps writing to log_file.
+    #     # max_size_mb: Size in MiB log_file may reach before it is rotated.
+    #     # Default: 100. An explicit 0 disables size based rotation. On POSIX
+    #     # SIGUSR2 can still rotate on demand; on Windows there is no such
+    #     # trigger, so an explicit 0 means the file is never rotated.
+    #     # max_files: Rotated files to retain, not counting the active file.
+    #     # Default: 7. An explicit 0 retains all of them.
